runtime.persistence: tenant-owned sites row deletion in a database transaction with authoritative post-delete absence verification

security.csrf: web CSRF protection is retained for DELETE; focused acceptance proves missing token fails closed without persistence change
security.tenant: active TenantContext is authoritative and route tenant must match it
security.idor: positive direct site ID is resolved with an explicit unscoped tenant_id + primary-key ownership query; foreign IDs and invalid IDs return 404
security.active_execution: queued or running execution for the active tenant/site returns 409 and preserves the site
security.secret_exposure: success is an empty 204 only; no credentials or provider secrets are returned

truthfulness.success: reported only after transactional delete and authoritative database absence verification, followed by frontend authoritative sites reread
truthfulness.failure: mutation or reread failure does not emit success; duplicate submission is suppressed while pending
truthfulness.replay: already-absent/direct-ID replay fails closed as not found
